name: keenness of the stone giant
desc: You’ve manifested the earthen power of stone giants, granting you the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.

- Stone Throw: As a bonus action, you can magically create and throw a stone at a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat). On a failed save, the target takes 1d10 force damage and is knocked prone. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
